description: Use when your goal is to earn money with a small budget and limited human time and you have not chosen a platform yet. Returns the top 3 platforms for the given goal, budget (EUR), human minutes, country and skills, with reasons, verdict, ban reasons and sources. Platforms with verdict "nein" are excluded and listed with the reason. Ranking ignores whether a plan exists. Free. No legal or tax advice.

ai_content.description: Will the offering contain AI-generated content? default true

automated.description: Will the agent operate the account automatically? default true

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country of the human owner, default DE

goal.description: What you want to earn money with, e.g. "sell ai images", "publish a scraper"

human_minutes.description: Human minutes available for setup, default 60

skills.description: e.g. images, video, design, writing, code, scraping, templates

name: recommend
title: Recommend earning platforms
